persona_snapshot.name: Skeptical bookkeeper
persona_snapshot.summary: Checks every number and doesn't accept an answer without the detail behind it.
persona_snapshot.speaking_style: Measured and exact. Asks for amounts and dates to be repeated, and says "let me just write that down".

scenario_snapshot.title: Expired SSL certificate
scenario_snapshot.description: Browsers show a security warning because the certificate expired. The bot should renew it at no charge.
scenario_snapshot.goal: Your cafe website shows a scary security warning and customers are calling you about it.

beats.instruction: Say your site shows a warning saying your connection is not private.
beats.checkpoint: The caller described the browser warning.

beats.instruction: Give your domain, then your billing zip and PIN when asked.
Ask if it will cost anything, then say yes to the renewal.
beats.checkpoint: The caller approved the SSL renewal.

must.text: Verify the caller before making changes.
Explain that the SSL certificate expired on October 21.
Say that the renewal is free with the website plan.

must_not.text: Charge the customer for the renewal.

expected_state.description: The certificate runs for another year.
No invoice was created or changed.
